tutorials.title: Getting started
tutorials.summary: Your seat, your name, inviting friends and the script.

steps.title: Welcome to Fearville
steps.body: This short tour shows where everything lives. Skip it at any step, and replay it any time from Help.

steps.title: Invite friends
steps.body: Friends join with the six-letter session code shown at the top of the screen. Read it out or show it to them.

steps.title: The script
steps.body: The Script tab lists every character this table can use, plus the key terms. It never shows who has which character.

steps.title: Next: the first night
steps.body: When everyone is seated, the Storyteller deals characters and the game begins. The tour continues then.

tutorials.title: Your character and the night
tutorials.summary: Revealing your character, Game flow, the clock and night prompts.

steps.title: Your character is private
steps.body: Scroll to Your private character and tap Reveal my character when no one else can see your screen. It hides again as soon as you leave the app.

steps.title: Game flow
steps.body: The Game tab always shows what is happening now: the phase, what the town is doing, and any actions you can use.

steps.title: The clock
steps.body: Timed phases count down here. The Storyteller can pause or extend the clock.

steps.title: Day and night
steps.body: By day the town talks, nominates and votes. At night everyone closes their eyes and the Storyteller works through the night in order. If you are asked for a choice, the Storyteller tells you in Messages and you reply there. Every player sees the same night screen.

steps.title: Messages
steps.body: Messages is your private line to the Storyteller. Anything meant only for you arrives here.

steps.title: Next: the first day
steps.body: Nominations and voting are covered when the first day begins.

tutorials.title: Nominations, voting and your tools
tutorials.summary: How to nominate and vote, plus notes, Help and settings.

steps.title: Nominations
steps.body: During nominations each living player may nominate once per day, and each player can be nominated once per day. When you can nominate, it appears under Actions in the Game tab.

steps.title: Voting
steps.body: When someone is nominated, vote before the timer ends. Votes are public. Dead players keep a single vote for the rest of the game.

steps.title: Help
steps.body: Replay this tour or any section guide from Help.

steps.title: Settings and account
steps.body: Settings opens from the gear. Return home from the top bar; your seat stays in the lobby.

steps.title: You are ready
steps.body: That is the tour. Good luck in Fearville.

tutorials.title: Game flow
tutorials.summary: What is happening now and what you can do.

steps.title: Game flow
steps.body: This is your home screen during play. It shows the current phase, what the town is doing, and any buttons you can use right now.

steps.title: Your seat
steps.body: Your private character and any actions you can take are further down this screen.

tutorials.title: Night actions
tutorials.summary: What happens on your screen at night.

steps.title: The night
steps.body: At night the Storyteller works through the night order. Your screen stays on the night view whatever your character.

steps.title: Night messages
steps.body: If you are asked for a choice, the Storyteller tells you in Messages. Reply there before the night moves on.

steps.title: Dawn
steps.body: Deaths from the night become public at dawn. Anything you learn at night stays in Messages.

tutorials.title: Seats
tutorials.summary: Everyone at the table and who is alive.

steps.title: Seats
steps.body: Seats lists everyone at the table in seat order, who is alive, and who still has a dead vote. Nominations used today show here too.

tutorials.title: Messages
tutorials.summary: Your private conversation with the Storyteller.

steps.title: Messages
steps.body: Your conversation with the Storyteller. Information meant only for you arrives here, and you can reply at any time.

steps.title: Everyone
steps.body: Messages marked Everyone were sent to the whole table. Private messages are never shown to other players during the game.

tutorials.title: Rules & roles
tutorials.summary: Every character on the script and the key terms.

steps.title: Rules & roles
steps.body: Every character on this script with the glossary of key terms. It lists the script, never who has which character.

steps.title: Key terms
steps.body: Underlined words open a short definition. Tap one to read it, and tap again to close.

steps.title: Session
steps.body: Your account keeps saved lobbies available across devices. Return home while keeping your seat. Help lives here too.

steps.title: Your account
steps.body: An account saves your seats across devices and keeps your record. Resume a saved game, connect another sign-in, or adjust your privacy here.

steps.title: Tutorials
steps.body: Signed in, each tutorial shows once. Use Show tutorials again in Settings to see them all from the start.
